virality_data.topic: Building a browser-based LaTeX compiler using WASM and pdfTeX to replace Overleaf
virality_data.analysis: Engineers and researchers are tired of slow, cloud-queued LaTeX compilation on platforms like Overleaf. This project taps into the high-demand niche of WebAssembly compilation directly on client machines with zero backend cost. It differentiates itself by showing how to compile raw pdfTeX into WASM in a clean modern web stack without heavy container setups.

virality_data.topic: Replacing complex Kafka/Celery queues with durable HTTP streams on object storage
virality_data.analysis: Data streaming architectures have become bloated and expensive for small-to-medium systems running Kafka clusters. This post breaks down the emerging architectural shift of using append-only object store streams over HTTP for durable, low-cost event messaging. It hits the sweet spot for backend developers looking for simplified, cost-effective infrastructure without sacrificing durability.
